description: Get a Specific User - Retrieve a specific user by ID from the account user list. The public API only exposes GET /users, so the tool fetches the full list and returns the matching user.

id.description: The user ID to look up

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: get_user

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.
